meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Cross-checked typed owner report evidence in version 3 receipts and evaluation spans, retained version 2 receipts, provider hold recovery, and the separate Agent Monitoring and Dashboard Commerce evidence against the merged PHP and observability guide.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the owner constructor authorization, CSRF and session-bound public download grant against the authentication guides and actual guest/owner fixtures.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the downloaded file resolver and schema field against the source contracts for product orders and payments. This route uses the authored page publication and enquiry grant.

content.review_note: Compared the merged one-column campaign shell and native receipt focus with the ordered file manifest, protected upload, revision gates, campaign-only UTC SQL timestamp binding and content/hosting guidance.

foundation.review_note: Compared the hosted page fields and private immutable binaries with the application and host storage contracts, deployment backup instructions, campaign-only SQL timestamp normalization and actual direct-path denial.

google-tags.review_note: Compared the updated integration and provider examples with the Google reporting and analytics contracts, and cross-reviewed native download links against the frontend skill.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the front-controller and Apache path guards, private resolution and upload errors with the shared request-boundary documentation.

interface.review_note: Checked the merged campaign reading column, native feedback and 44px underlined download links with editor selection, preview, lock and mobile design contracts.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the download grant placement after a confirmed enquiry and the unchanged local receipt path against the documented held mail and owner Inbox boundary.

mcp-clients.review_note: Checked the merged Integrations guide against the local MCP client controller and form. The owner issues and revokes a paid-sales grant, and the trusted STDIO client receives it through its process environment.

media.review_note: Reviewed the independent private download storage against the existing owner Media Library, header image and deletion documentation. Download files keep their own private root.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the Enterprise Agent navigation, Site analytics and Dashboard Commerce guides with the merged layout and views. Verified that the authorized conversation export and staff review preserve saved report observations, guardrail status and original legacy receipts. Checked the merged authored-page media workflow and preserved existing publication and owner access boundaries. Reviewed the merged campaign enquiry and owner Inbox guidance. Business article and report evidence remain scoped to their agent tools. Reviewed published blog evidence and the separately scoped authored-page download and storage guides in the merged tree.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared the new public HTTP route with the MCP capability and discoverability contracts. Campaign assets do not extend the existing agent tool surface.

remote-commerce.review_note: Checked the authored-page revision write and schema addition against the remote-checkout contract. Validated public download links use the separate published-page resolver and campaign-only UTC database envelope bindings.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Cross-checked the generated route inventory and revised content review dependencies. The existing campaign HTTP and browser CI entries exercise the new behaviors.
